description_en: Queries some of the default configuration parameters for a Tair (Redis-compatible) instance
description_zh: 查询云数据库 Tair（兼容 Redis）实例的部分默认配置参数信息
name: DescribeInstanceConfig

parameters.help_en: The instance ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/473778.html operation to obtain this ID
parameters.name: instance_id

Config.description_en: The default configuration parameters of the instance. To view the full list of parameters, call the [DescribeParameters]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/473847.html） operation
Config.description_zh: 实例的默认配置参数，更全面的参数配置请调用[Describeparamters]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/473847.html）接口

ParamNoLooseSentinelEnabled.description_en:
Specifies whether to enable Sentinel compatibility mode. This parameter applies only to non-cluster instances. Valid values:

no (default): Disabled

yes: Enabled

For more information, see [Sentinel compatibility mode]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/178911.html）
ParamNoLooseSentinelEnabled.description_zh:
哨兵兼容模式，适用于非集群实例。取值说明：
no（默认）：未开启
yes：开启
更多信息请参见[Sentinel兼容模式]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/178911.html）

ParamNoLooseSentinelPasswordFreeAccess.description_en:
Specifies whether to allow password-free execution of Sentinel commands when Sentinel compatibility mode is enabled. Valid values:

no (default): Disabled.

yes: Enabled. Allows you to run Sentinel commands on any connection without a password and use the `SENTINEL` command to subscribe to the `+switch-master` channel
ParamNoLooseSentinelPasswordFreeAccess.description_zh:
开启哨兵模式时，是否允许免密执行Sentinel相关命令，取值说明：
no（默认）：关闭。
yes：开启。开启后，可以在任意连接上免密执行Sentinel命令以及使用SENTINEL命令监听+switch-master通道

ParamNoLooseSentinelPasswordFreeCommands.description_en: Additional commands that can be run without a password. This parameter is valid only when Sentinel compatibility mode is enabled and `ParamNoLooseSentinelPasswordFreeAccess` is set to `yes`. By default, this parameter is empty
ParamNoLooseSentinelPasswordFreeCommands.description_zh: 启用哨兵模式及ParamNoLooseSentinelPasswordFreeAccess参数后，可通过本参数添加额外的免密命令列表（默认为空）

ParamReplMode.description_en:
The replication mode. Valid values:

async (default): asynchronous mode

semisync: semi-synchronous mode
ParamReplMode.description_zh:
同步模式：
async（默认）：异步模式
semisync：半同步模式

ParamReplTimeout.description_en:
The degradation threshold for the semi-synchronous mode. This parameter is valid only in semi-synchronous mode. Unit: milliseconds. Valid values: 10 to 60000. Default value: 500.

If replication latency exceeds this threshold, the replication mode degrades to asynchronous mode. When the replication latency returns to normal, the mode reverts to semi-synchronous mode
ParamReplTimeout.description_zh:
半同步模式的降级阈值。仅半同步支持配置该参数，单位为ms，取值范围为10~60000，默认为500。
当同步延迟超出该阈值时，同步模式会自动转为异步，当同步延迟消除后，同步模式会自动转换为半同步

ParamSentinelCompatEnable.description_en:
Specifies whether to enable Sentinel compatibility mode. This parameter applies to instances that use the cluster architecture with proxy connection mode or the read/write splitting architecture. Valid values:

0 (default): Disabled

1: Enabled

For more information, see [Sentinel compatibility mode]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/178911.html）
ParamSentinelCompatEnable.description_zh:
哨兵兼容模式，适用于集群架构代理连接模式或读写分离架构的实例，取值说明：
0（默认）：未开启
1：开启
更多信息请参见[Sentinel兼容模式]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/178911.html）
